complaints.title: 2nd floor pc not working
complaints.description:
I would like to bring to your kind attention a few technical issues I am facing with the Smartflow system and my PC:

I am unable to attend calls received through Smartflow properly.

My PC hangs frequently, approximately every 2–3 days, which affects my work.

WhatsApp frequently gets logged out.

Missed calls are not displayed in Smartflow, due to which I may not be able to identify and respond to missed patient calls.

Due to these issues, patients are facing considerable inconvenience, especially when their calls are missed or delayed.

I kindly request you to please look into these issues and provide a permanent solution at the earliest.

Thank you for your support and assistance.

Regards,Dr. Priyanka MistryClinical Coordinator2nd Floor
